This is the last field in the call, so no trailing comma is added."}], "notes": "The failure is caused by the unsupported extra Field kwarg `cli=` on all four fields (input_file, max_records, min_filter_score, max_filter_score). Each is moved into json_schema_extra, which is the Pydantic v2 replacement. The earlier config migration (class Config -> model_config = ConfigDict(...)) is already in place and is left unchanged. Two things to watch: (1) the original Config inherited from ExampleConfigDefaults, which no longer appears in this file. I could not verify what that base set, so please confirm no defaults were lost. (2) The `CLI_SHELL_COMPLETION_ENABLE` key passed to ConfigDict is not a real Pydantic config key. It does not raise at runtime, so it is left as is. pydantic_cli/core.py must read the 'cli' metadata from field.json_schema_extra rather than the v1 field extras. That is handled in core.py, not here. The commented-out `extras={'cli': ...}` lines are comments only and are left untouched."}
